newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June 1st 10 days trade surplus up 31.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan June 1st 10 days trade surplus up 31.5 pct.

text.p: Japan posted a customs-cleared trade surplus of 149.82 billion yen in the first 10 days of June, up 31.5 percent from a revised surplus of 113.94 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
This compared with a trade deficit of 43.26 billion yen in the first 10 days of May.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 18.4 percent from a year earlier to 1.23 trillion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 16.8 percent to 1.08 trillion yen.
